notes.title: A simple update patch
notes.content:
1. The brightness prompts of swarm flying insects have been improved, and they can now be more clearly detected.

2. Slightly enlarged the arrow UI of the main target prompt in the game

3. Fixed the bug that some options in the cursor setting and ranking panel could not be selected when controlled by the handle.

4. Improved the refresh probability of stores in the map. Now the fewer the total number of stores in the map, the higher the refresh probability.

5. Lowered the blood volume of the boss in the later period.

6. The difficulty of classic mode has been reduced. Now the threat level of classic mode increases more slowly and the enemy's HP increases less.

7. Increased the number of gold coins taken out at the settlement of each mode.

notes.title: Coming Soon! Watch developers play!
notes.content:
"Before the Dawn" is a top-down shooting + roguelike game. It will be officially launched at 14:00 (GMT+8) on April 18th. In a city with a zombie outbreak, upgrade weapons, drive vehicles, search for supplies, and activate communication towers to get rescued! Facing the zombie tide, build a strategic combination and use overwhelming firepower to open a bloody path! Players who like meat pigeon mowing games are welcome to come and try it out and buy it!
We will broadcast live on Steam on April 18th, everyone is welcome to watch and discuss together!

Live broadcast time: 14:00 on April 18 (GMT+8)

notes.title: Before the Dawn will be available on April 18th!
notes.content:
Before the Dawn will be available on April 18th! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43285726/0b065ff8fd9d5ef57346f2f1e932f8a7de9ea065.png[/img]

In the game, players can unlock characters and skills with different characteristics. According to their characteristics and your style, match a variety of combat weapons and skills to find your own combat build!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43285726/b90ef1744ab8bdd2ac069ffaa68c218879911735.png[/img]

Compared with the traditional roguelike games, Before the Dawn adds a vehicle system, allowing players to give full play to their imagination and build their own abilities with vehicles. Quickly find ways to strengthen yourself and escape in the apocalypse. There are various types of vehicles in the game, and different types have different advantages. Explore your favorite vehicles and go on an adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43285726/ceac6a865db97d06c699b85042ff77cce1846487.png[/img]

As a roguelike game, character growth within a single game is essential. Characters can choose their favorite genre through the free combination of skills, treasures, and weapons. Do you want to use a rocket launcher to blast zombies wildly, or use a shotgun to experience the thrill of critical strikes, or choose a laser gun to feel the power of technology. Or you can choose to engage in a head-on battle, so that can planted mines and used satellite rays to trick the zombies. The choice is yours!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43285726/71f08a3cf3650a7db17ae38f0c5b84c26c07431d.png[/img]

In the city, you will also meet survivors like you, help them and let them join the team to fight together!

At the same time, this game has four modes. In one round, you can experience traditional roguelike mode, tower defense mode, exploration mode and survivor mode. Different game modes can bring you completely different gaming experiences!

There are various skill combinations in the game. If you learn the combination skills at the same time, you will also have unexpected ultimate skills, which can improve the character's ability to face stronger BOSS.

The different difficulties and modes in the game make this game extremely playable and replayable. When players find that it is difficult to defeat difficult enemies with their current abilities, they can collect more resources to strengthen the outside development system. Organize your thoughts before entering into this battle with zombies again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43285726/71f08a3cf3650a7db17ae38f0c5b84c26c07431d.png[/img]
